name: keys-jev-optimizer
description: Bounded Jev context optimization through the KeysReallySafe gateway.

goal.title: Compaction goal
goal.description: Optional task goal used when evaluating context relevance. Leave unset to infer the goal from the latest user prompts.

apiKey.title: Standalone Vercel key
apiKey.description: For standalone Vercel use only. Leave unset when using the Keys launcher: its temporary grant overrides saved credentials for either Vercel or TypeSafe.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Keep probability at or above which the item stays; 0.2 preserves uncertain evidence.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when the model decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

model.title: Evaluation model
model.description: Standalone Vercel model ID. A Keys scoped launcher connection selects its reviewed provider model (typesafe-ai/jev or jev-latest), overriding this setting.

baseUrl.title: Gateway endpoint URL
baseUrl.description: Standalone Vercel endpoint override. Must be https, or http on localhost. The key and conversation state are sent here. The Keys launcher overrides this setting with its exact local scoped endpoint.

minRemovableChars.title: Minimum removable characters
minRemovableChars.description: Skip evaluation when eligible output text cannot remove this many characters; not a token or dollar estimate.

maxCandidates.title: Maximum outputs scored
maxCandidates.description: Score the largest eligible outputs only; all others remain unchanged.

maxDecisionInputTokens.title: Total estimated decision input budget
maxDecisionInputTokens.description: Maximum estimated input across uncached requests, including repeated state; checked before any request.

maxRequests.title: Maximum evaluation requests
maxRequests.description: Maximum uncached requests per compaction, checked before sending any.

maxConcurrency.title: Evaluation concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum simultaneous evaluation requests; clamped to 1–8.

minContextGrowthTokens.title: Automatic compaction growth gate
minContextGrowthTokens.description: Minimum new context tokens between early automatic compaction attempts.

mode.title: Optimization mode
mode.description: apply prunes eligible history. observe measures only on early automatic runs; manual and host compactions use the built-in summarizer.
